description: In-place 1.23.0 -> 1.24.0 change (lane K, code 10): kdef.width-allocation locator/limits, window.recipe-rules claim, the 13 wnd# window cases' size offsets (-12 added) and their 13 window.flag-gated-parts rationales/evidence/assertions; appended evidence kdef.too-short-step; scope description sentence. Statuses and requirements unchanged.

priorEvidence.locator:
| 12 | **TILE** — `dstW = floor(slack/numStretch / srcW) * srcW` (whole tiles) | `0x5266`-`0x5292` |
| 8, 11, 18 | **STRETCH (grow)** — `share = sVar5/sVar6 + slack/numStretch` | `0x529e`-`0x52d6` |
| 13, 14 | **STRETCH** smaller share (`sVar5/sVar6`, no slack term) | `0x52da`-`0x52f8` |
| else | call `0x49d6(pc,flag)`: nonzero → leave width 0 (budget participant); else FIXED `dstW=srcW`; **except** pc∈{5,6} AND flag==0 → width 0 (collapse) | `0x52fc`-`0x532a` |

So **codes 5/6** (title bezel) are FIXED when the title fits (`flag`=`fp@(-290)`
title-fits, pushed at `0x5100`/`0x5120`) and **collapse to 0** when it doesn't —
they never grow. Budget = `slack = (srcBorder[end]−srcBorder[start-1]) − reqWidth`
(`0x518a`); the primary divisor counts only 8/11/12/18 (`0x4b3e`), while 8/11/13/14/18
share the division and whole-tile remainder. Each remainder share is truncated
against the number of recipients still to visit, so extra pixels accumulate at
the END of the walk (3/3/4 for a budget of 10 and three ordinary growers)
priorEvidence.claim: Two-pass per-half allocation: primary 8/11/12/18, whole-tile truncation, remainder to 8/11/13/14/18 toward the end; 0x49d6 stretch verdicts leave width 0.
priorEvidence.limits: Within one half of a given extent with a nonnegative budget. Title-anchor half extents, codes 5/6 (title-fits flag, 0x5312), widget flag values and below-minimum behaviour are not established.

priorAssertions.claim: Every sliced window type, both states, 15 sampled content sizes: END-based cells, 1:1 leading corner, flag-independent part-code widths, per-half 0x5178 allocation (nonnegative budgets; observed titled-half extent) and opaque pixels of 1px-run non-18 cells (direction-independent; runtime cross-axis placement); zero failures, nonvacuous counts.
